_comment: The Trusted Signing account for CI, which differs from the copy beside
the repository root in exactly one way: which credential types
The local file excludes everything except AzureCliCredential, so that a
signature is authorised by the maintainer's own `az login` session and by
nothing else. A runner has no such session. It authenticates with an OIDC
token GitHub mints for the workflow, which `azure/login` exchanges for an
access token and puts in the environment, so EnvironmentCredential and
WorkloadIdentityCredential are the two that must stay enabled here.
Everything interactive stays excluded: a credential type that can open a
browser has no business in a non-interactive job, where it would hang
until the step times out instead of failing.
The account and profile names are not secrets; the authorisation to use
them is. See doc/updates-plan.md and doc/windows.md.
